name: Llywelyn
text: Llywelyn is a name borne by several princes of medieval Wales. The most of them, Llywelyn the Great and Llywelyn the Last, are recorded under their own titles. The base name also marks a princely owner of a faithful hound in folk-tale.

attributes.attribute: name of several medieval Welsh princes
